Maria: Quick sync — need final bench narrative for April 7 webinar :rocket:
Aj: Can we narrow to 3 core vignettes? SMB demo, Platform TCO, and graceful degradation/fallbacks
Deepa: +1. For the public deck I want a short 'sizzle' hero and a compact 'deep' appendix with numbers :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sam: Data check — our 50th/95th/99th latency vs cost scatter is ready. sample config for the viz:
Sam: ```chart_type: scatter
x: latency_ms
y: cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
color: model_family
size: qps
points: aggregated_by_route
```
Noah: I'll mock 3 wireframes: hero with single stat, split-slate (sizzle + metric), and appendix page for methodology. headline -> caption -> CTA flow
Aj: Inbound routing proposal: tag signups by intent: `bench-enterprise`, `bench-smb`, `bench-research` then route: SDR -> SE -> solutions depending on tag and usage signal
Deepa: Draft hero copy options:
Deepa: A) "Serve LLMs predictably — faster, cheaper, everywhere."
Deepa: B) "Cut inference costs 3x without sacrificing tail latency."
Deepa: C) "Same outputs. Less spend. Fewer surprises."
Maria: I prefer B for PLG ad, A on enterprise page. We should A/B test B vs C on paid traffic
Sam: Small ask: append raw median/99 numbers, token counting assumptions, batching profile, and quantization notes in appendix. I'll upload CSV with the sample rows and calculations by EOD
Noah: Design note: use a tiny sparkline under the hero showing cost per 1k tokens as load scales; separate chart for tail latency to show degradation points
Maria: Action items: @Sam attach CSV by EOD, @Noah produce 3 wireframes by Wed, @Deepa finalize hero copy and CTAs, @Aj set up routing tags and email templates. I'll draft a 20-min webinar outline and script first pass
deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar signup form deployed to /marketing/bench-april7 at 1765301250
Aj: :thumbsup: Keeping this tight. Thanks all — sync Thurs for review.
